title: Original GTA Artist Flattered by GTA 6 Cover Art Influence
description: Former Rockstar Games artist Stephen Bliss shares his thoughts on seeing his iconic visual style continue in the cover art for GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Visual Legacy of Grand Theft Auto

When gamers think of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise, iconic elements immediately come to mind: sprawling open worlds, gripping criminal narratives, and, perhaps most distinctively, the legendary cover art and promotional illustrations. These stylized, multi-panel character portraits have defined the aesthetic of the series for generations. Recently, according to a report by IGN Games, Stephen Bliss, the former Rockstar Games artist who played a pivotal role in establishing this iconic visual style, spoke out about seeing his design language live on in the highly anticipated *GTA 6*.

## A Painterly Tradition Carried Forward

As one of the creative forces behind the look and feel of past entries, Stephen Bliss helped forge the artistic identity that millions of fans recognize instantly. In his recent remarks, Bliss shared that he feels genuinely "flattered" to witness elements of his original designs continuing to appear in the cover art for *GTA 6*.

While Rockstar Games continually pushes technological boundaries with each new hardware generation, maintaining a consistent artistic thread is crucial for brand identity. Bliss's acknowledgment highlights how foundational art direction can cast a long, positive shadow over subsequent installments, ensuring that the soul of the franchise remains intact even as the setting and technology evolve.

## Connecting Past and Future Artistry

As anticipation for *GTA 6* reaches a fever pitch across the global gaming community, every piece of official visual media is scrutinized and celebrated by fans. Industry observers note that retaining the classic pop-art collage aesthetic bridges the gap between longtime veterans and new players. Bliss's reaction underscores a respectful continuity within the studio's artistic lineage, proving that the roots planted by past developers continue to inspire modern iterations.

## Editor's Take

Stephen Bliss's positive reaction to the *GTA 6* cover art highlights the importance of artistic continuity in long-running franchises. It's a heartwarming nod that bridges past eras of Rockstar Games with its modern masterpieces, proving that truly great design leaves a lasting imprint on the industry.
